parsed.claim: For any compact K in Space n with nonempty interior, normalizedVolume K is strictly positive (and finite), and the identity function is integrable on K. So the junk-value cases of `barycenter` (zero volume, non-integrable integrand) do not occur under the main theorem's hypotheses, and `barycenter S = 0` is the genuine centering condition.
parsed.lean:
theorem probe_barycenter_genuine {n : ℕ} (K : Set (Ehrhart.Space n)) (hc : IsCompact K)
    (hi : (interior K).Nonempty) :
    0 < Ehrhart.normalizedVolume K ∧
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun x : Ehrhart.Space n => x) K MeasureTheory.volume := by
  constructor
  · unfold Ehrhart.normalizedVolume
    have h1 : 0 < (MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure (Ehrhart.Space n)) (interior K) :=
      isOpen_interior.measure_pos _ hi
    have h2 : 0 < (MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure (Ehrhart.Space n)) K :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le h1 (MeasureTheory.measure_mono interior_subset)
    exact ENNReal.toReal_pos h2.ne' hc.measure_lt_top.ne
  · exact continuous_id.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact hc
